fact: Radio Okapi, reproduced on 10 May 2025, reports that a UNICEF digitalisation pilot in five communes of Tshangu (Kinshasa) delivered 27,814 birth certificates in a year, with newborn data entered digitally from the maternity, a test phase ending in July 2024 and funding for extension to all Kinshasa unresolved.
title: RDC : 27 814 enfants sortis de l'ombre grâce à la digitalisation de l'état civil
